note: Differences between the request the definitions build and the one the existing Create page sends when a user does the same things on it (tools/compare-request.ts). Each entry names exactly what it covers: one field, the engines, the state (a condition on the desk, and parameters set or left alone) and what each side sends there: a value, "absent", "sent" (any value) or "value:<key>" (that parameter's value). Any other difference fails, and an entry that no longer occurs on one of its engines fails too. Every entry is a question to the maintainer in docs/08-open-questions.md; until it is answered the entry records what the new page would do differently.

differences.definitions: what they send with every module, pedal and unit on the desk
differences.why: A module, pedal or unit not on the desk reads as its defaults, so what it was set to is not sent, as the concept's page does (generate() reads Takes and Tempo only while they are on the desk). The existing page has no desk: it keeps sending what the user set. Accepted only where putting everything on the desk makes the definitions send exactly what the existing page sends.

The concept starts ACE-Step's Shift on Auto (-1): the engine then works out a shift from the song's length and the step count (hot-step-server.cpp: 3 times a length factor and a steps factor, each 0.8 to 1.4, so about 1.9 to 5.9; 3.18 at 12 steps and 60 s, 4.13 at 12 steps and 3:00), on every model. The existing page starts at 3.0. Whether the Sampler is on the desk does not change this: a module off the desk reads as its defaults, and its default is Auto.
With Lua plugins on and the solver left alone, the definitions send Native (the engine's own loop), as the concept starts it; the existing page sends the shared picker's euler.
As native-solver, for the schedule: the existing page sends linear.
As native-solver, for the guidance: the existing page sends APG.

Stable Audio 3 reads guidanceScale only with Lua plugins on. The concept starts it at 1; the existing page has no guidance control on Stable Audio 3 and sends ACE-Step's 9.
As sa3-guidance-default, once the guidance is set on the new page: the existing page cannot set it there.
The concept offers Expand wildcards on YuE2 and the server honours it there; the existing page hides the switch on YuE2.
The definitions add Auto to the renderer and apply the TensorRT precision on Auto (the server picks TensorRT when the machine has it); the existing page shows the precision only on TensorRT.
The existing page sends HeartMuLa's selected scalar decoder with every request, so a queued job keeps it; the concept's engine panel has no row for it.

The concept shows MiniMax-Music3's schedule shift only with Lua plugins on. The server also reads it with plugins off, for low-step compensation under 30 steps (mapMinimaxSamplerPlugins): the existing page sends the shift set there, the definitions leave the server's automatic shift.
The concept offers the tiled decoder on Stable Audio 3; the existing page shows it only on engines with ACE-Step's plugin registry (features.plugins), so it cannot be turned on there.

The server shows HeartMuLa's schedule shift only with Lua plugins on (visible_when on samplerPluginsEnabled); the existing page keeps sending a shift set before they were turned off, the definitions send it only while they are on.

The server shows the plan name only while the next plan is saved (visible_when on mm3SaveHiddens); the existing page keeps sending a name typed before.

The existing page offers Add trigger to caption only for an adapter whose metadata has a trigger word, and sends nothing otherwise; the concept offers the switch with any adapter, and the definitions send it once set. The engine adds a trigger only when the adapter has one.

The definitions send the seed on the desk while it is not kept; the existing page cannot type a seed while Random is on, so it sends its stored one. With randomSeed on the engine draws its own either way.

The concept shows the alignment timing only while the lyrics carry per-section adapter directives, which is when the engine reads it; the existing page shows it with any stack and sends what it is set to.

A window of 0 refines the whole song at once, so there is no overlap: the existing page disables the overlap field then and keeps its stored value; the concept keeps the overlap knob live and the definitions send what it is set to.
